decision: Keep direct trusted-LAN HTTP available by default with HTTPS_ONLY=false. HTTPS reverse-proxy operation is an explicit opt-in using HTTPS_ONLY=true.
authorization: Product owner explicitly requested local operation without HTTPS on 2026-10-07. Existing SETUP-001 already specifies this local deployment profile.
constraints: Keep authentication, HttpOnly cookies, SameSite protection, CSRF and revocable sessions in both modes.
HTTP mode does not send HSTS or a CSP directive that upgrades local resources to HTTPS.
The HTTPS option configures browser/session policy and does not provide TLS termination.
